name: Profile hero
summary: The top of a person's profile: a cover photo, their photo in a story ring, name, handle and tags, a short bio with a link, posts, followers and following, Follow and Message, and a row of story highlights with photo covers.
use: at the top of a profile page in a social or creator app
a11y: The name is the section heading, Follow is a toggle with aria-pressed that also updates the follower count, the counts and highlights are buttons with visible text, the cover photo has a description, and the profile photo and highlight covers are decorative next to their visible names.

use_when: a creator or member page where following, messaging and story highlights matter more than account details
avoid_when: a small person card inside a list or popover: use profile-card
a work record such as a company or deal with tabs: use page-header-tabs
suggesting several people to follow: use follow-suggestions

parts.name: cover
parts.what: a wide cover photo with a description

parts.name: avatar
parts.what: the person's photo in an accent story ring, overlapping the cover

parts.name: name
parts.what: the person's name, the section heading

parts.name: handle
parts.what: the handle, then small tags such as pronouns or a role

parts.name: counts
parts.what: posts, followers and following, each a button

parts.name: follow
parts.what: a Follow toggle that reads Following when on and adds one to the follower count

parts.name: similar
parts.what: an icon button for similar accounts

parts.name: highlights
parts.what: one story highlight: a round photo cover and a short title; the last may be New

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if following fails, put the button back to Follow, restore the count and show a toast-stack message

disabled.how: for a blocked or private account, set disabled on Message and add a :disabled style; there is none now

overflow.how: highlights scroll sideways in their own row with a fade at the right edge
overflow.evidence: overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; overscroll-behavior-x: contain

long_text.how: highlight titles end in an ellipsis, tags and buttons never wrap, and the handle line wraps
long_text.evidence: max-inline-size: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the bio link, the posts, followers and following counts, Follow, Message, Similar accounts, then each highlight
Enter or Space on Follow follows or unfollows and updates the follower count
Enter or Space presses any other button; Enter follows the link
